text:
maya: quick ping — who's up for the quiet window tomorrow 11:00pm–1:00am PST for the user_profiles schema change? need dual-write + a small backfill. tagging owners @arjun @lucy

arjun: i'm the deploy owner, can take this. how many rows in the backfill? any long running steps? :thinking:

maya: ~120k rows, backfill script estimated ~12m with current batch size. plan is canary first then scale if fine.

lucy: i'll be on-call for the window, monitoring p95/p99 and DB replication lag. cancel if p99 > 400ms or lag > 60s. add me to pager for that slot.

tom: infra question — can we reserve the 2x g4 warmup pool at 10:30pm PST so we don't hit cold-starts? if yes i'll create a slot and warmup machines.

deploy-bot: Slot created: 1765439999-slot-382. Reminder scheduled at 22:30 PST.

arjun: deployment plan (high level): 22:30 warmup, 23:00 flip to dual-write, 23:15 run backfill canary at 10%, 23:30 ramp to full backfill. rollback criteria: >2% errors on write path OR replication lag >60s for >5m.

maya: quick smoke checklist we should run during canary: sample migrated rows query, user login flow, embedding pipeline sanity. @kate can you confirm product tests you'll run?

kate: i can run login smoke and search sanity. i'll be on call from 22:45 and will post results here.

lucy: smoke commands i plan to run (copy/paste):
```bash
# check migrated count
psql -c "select count(*) from user_profiles where migrated = true;"
# check replica lag
curl -s http://replica-metrics:9090/lag | jq .
```

arjun: also run `curl -s https://api.redwood.dev/healthz` and spot-check 5 user flows (login, profile fetch, update, search, embed).

tom: warmup done — i created the slot and uploaded the migration binary to s3: s3://redwood-artifacts/migrations/u_profiles-v3.tar.gz

maya: rollback plan summary: disable dual-write via feature-flag, stop backfill, run compensating backfill if needed, and revert any schema flags. execution owners: @arjun to run, @lucy to validate telemetry and give rollback approval.

lucy: i'll draft the alert runbook and a minimal dashboard (p95, p99, write errors, replica lag). will share link pre-deploy.

arjun: one last Q — who is the cutover approver at T-15?
maya: me. i'll post go/no-go in this thread at T-15.

kate: noted. i'll post product test results live during the canary.

maya: thanks all. if no objections i'll lock the slot and post the final checklist by EOD.

arjun: no objections from me. :thumbsup:

lucy: :thumbsup:

tom: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder will be sent 2 hours before the window (automated).
